import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
sys.path.insert(0, data["support"])
namespace = {"__name__": "more_itertools.more", "__package__": "more_itertools", "__file__": "<frozen-source>"}
exec(compile(data["source"], "<frozen-source>", "exec"), namespace)
cls = namespace["numeric_range"]
if data["operation"] == "large_length":
    r = cls(1e16, 1e16 + 4, 1e-12)
    n = len(r)
    correct = n > 0 and 1e16 + (n - 1) * 1e-12 < 1e16 + 4 <= 1e16 + n * 1e-12
    print(json.dumps({"passed": correct, "length": n, "boundary_matches_iteration_formula": correct}))
else:
    r = cls(1e16, 1e16 + 4, 0.1)
    items = list(iter(r))
    expected = items.index(1e16 + 2)
    actual = r.index(1e16 + 2)
    print(json.dumps({"passed": actual == expected, "index": actual, "expected_first_index": expected, "bounded_iteration_count": len(items)}))
